Term1: Complicated intra-abdominal infections: secondary peritonitis, intraabdominal abscess, intraperitoneal abscess (Navigation)

# COMPLICATED INTRA-ABDOMINAL INFECTIONS: SECONDARY PERITONITIS, INTRAABDOMINAL ABSCESS, INTRAPERITONEAL ABSCESS

[Oral step-down treatment](step-down-treatment)

Complicated intra-abdominal infections (cIAI) include any infectious process that extends from an intra-abdominal organ into a sterile space and is associated with peritonitis with or without abscess

Community-acquired cIAI: patients without recent procedure related to site of perforation or abscess
Healthcare-associated cIAI: patients developing a new infection > 48 hours after an incident intra-abdominal procedure

## Primary therapy: abscess drainage

CT or US-guided percutaneous or surgical drainage should be considered in all cases for diagnostic confirmation, microbiologic evaluation, and therapy.

## Duration of antimicrobial therapy

Adequate source control: 4 days after source control
Incomplete source control and no abscess: 5-7 days tailored to improvement.
Re-evaluate need for source control if ongoing signs/symptoms of infection beyond 7 days
Abscess: 2-6 weeks depending on resolution on repeat imaging. ID Consult recommended.

Therapy:
## Community-acquired infection without severe illness or immunosuppression

Preferred:
Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q24h for 5 days [M] <AND> metronidazole 500 mg IV q8h [DI]

Alternative:
Assessment of Beta-lactam Reaction
Ciprofloxacin 400 mg IV q12h [R,DI] <AND> metronidazole 500 mg IV q8h [DI]

## Healthcare-associated infection, severe illness, or immunosuppression

Preferred:
Piperacillin-tazobactam 4.5 gm IV q6h [R]

Alternative:
Cefepime 2 gm IV q8h [R] <AND> metronidazole 500 mg IV q8h [DI]

Alternative for severe beta-lactam reaction:
Assessment of Beta-lactam Reaction
Ciprofloxacin 400 mg IV q8h [R] <AND> metronidazole 500 mg IV q8h [DI]

Consider vancomycin for enterococcal coverage in critically ill or immunosuppressed patients:
<ADD> vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h [R] to one of the regimens above
